Newsletter

Letters, rarely.

One message when something is actually worth telling you about: a new collection, a new essay, a recording added to Perennis. Not a weekly schedule.

Join the letter

What you receive

New pieces and restocks, Journal essays, and additions to the Perennis library. No countdowns, no daily reminders, and no sharing of your address.

How it is stored

Until the mailing service is connected, the address is saved only in this browser under aura_newsletter_v1. Nothing is sent to a server, and the preference can be removed on this page.

The mailing service is not connected yet. This form stores the preference locally and explains what will happen when it is.
